name: octopus-teardown
description: Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus, rebuilt with the teardown skill

scripts.pages: npm run build && mkdir -p docs && cp teardown-out/dist/octopus-live.html docs/index.html && cp teardown-out/dist/octopus-film.html docs/film.html && cp teardown-out/dist/bee-live.html docs/bee.html && cp teardown-out/dist/bee-film.html docs/bee-film.html && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.video:freedom: node .claude/skills/teardown/sims/capture.mjs freedom-film --size 1600x900 --dpr 1.2 --out teardown-out/freedom-silent.mp4 && python3 .claude/skills/teardown/run_sfx.py sims/freedom-shared/score.py && ffmpeg -y -i teardown-out/freedom-silent.mp4 -i teardown-out/freedom-score.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart teardown-out/freedom.mp4
